manifest.name: dsh-wsl-glab
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness WSL plugin: read-only glab MR/issue/ci status.

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: dsh-wsl-glab
      name: dsh-wsl-glab
      config:
        enabled: true
        timeoutMs: 30000

declared.name: glab_status
declared.description: Whether glab is on PATH; version + auth status summary (never returns tokens).

declared.name: glab_mr_list
declared.description: List merge requests (json summary). Optional repo path group/project.

declared.name: glab_ci_status
declared.description: glab ci status for current pipeline (read-only summary text).

declared.name: timeoutMs
declared.description: Positive timeout in milliseconds; defaults to 30000.

readme.text:
> **语言：** **中文**（本页） · [English](./README.en.md)

GitLab CLI（glab）只读：MR / issue / ci status。

| | |
|---|---|
| 版本 | **0.1.0** |
| 套件 | [dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit) **可选**，不在 `install.sh` |

| 工具 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `glab_status` | glab 版本 |
| `glab_mr_list` | MR 列表 |
| `glab_issue_list` | Issue 列表 |
| `glab_ci_status` | 流水线状态 |

`timeoutMs`

不创建/合并 MR。认证走 glab 自己的配置。互补 `dsh-wsl-github`。

| 字段 | 值 |
|------|----|
| **插件** | `dsh-wsl-glab` **0.1.1** |
| **最低 dsh** | ≥ **0.1.2**（Web UI 一次性 `?token=`，Windows 中继 `:3081`） |
| **最新验证** | 以 [dsh-wsl-kit 兼容性](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#compatibility-2026-09) 为准（当前 **`0.2.2-rc.1`**）— 套件唯一真源 |
| **套件档位** | 可选（默认不在 `install.sh` / `KIT_SET=daily`） |

> **Languages:** [中文（首页）](./README.md) · **English** (this file)

Read-only glab MR/issue/ci status.

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | **0.1.0** |
| Kit | Optional companion to [dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit); not in `install.sh` |

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-wsl-glab
```

Batch link (optional): `bash dsh-wsl-kit/scripts/link-linux-plugins.sh`

| Tool | Role |
|------|------|
| `glab_status` | glab version |
| `glab_mr_list` | MR list |
| `glab_issue_list` | issue list |
| `glab_ci_status` | ci status |

`timeoutMs`

No create/merge. Auth via glab config. Complements `dsh-wsl-github`.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Plugin** | `dsh-wsl-glab` **0.1.1** |
| **Minimum dsh** | ≥ **0.1.2** (web UI one-shot `?token=` on Windows relay `:3081`) |
| **Latest verified** | See [dsh-wsl-kit Compatibility](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#compatibility-2026-09) (currently **`0.2.2-rc.1`**) — single source of truth for the suite |
| **Kit set** | optional (not in `install.sh` / `KIT_SET=daily` by default) |
